description:
Half-Life Advanced Effects (HLAE) is a tool to enrich Source (mainly CS:GO) engine based movie making.


- Included AfxHookSource 1.135.2 (2026-09-12T14:47Z)
- Included AfxHookSource2 0.41.2 (2026-09-12T14:47Z)
AfxHookSource 1.135.2 (2026-09-12T14:47Z)
- Adjusted to be compatible with latest Garry's Mod update. Thanks @Devostated
AfxHookSource2 0.41.2 (2026-09-12T14:47Z)
- Merged latest version of alpha matte mirv_streams, see wiki for example. Thanks @papesgit for initial research/code and @dtugend for implementation.
- Fixed low FPS player animations / stuttering in recordings by adding mirv_fix forceClInterpRatio, which is enabled by default.
Includes changes from HLAE 2.192.0 and 2.192.1 pre-releases for AfxHookSource2
- Small mirv_streams improvements with regards to world / matte / viewmodel streams.
- Fixed #1199 spec_show_xray 1 makes the game crash when using demo_goto with xplay.gg demos.
- Added mirv_streams settings presets afxFfmpegProres and afxFfmpegProresAlpha (works for Source 1 games too).
- Added mirv_streams features mostly based on contributions by @papesgit
